name: How long does a typical roof installation take?

mainEntity.name: How long does a typical roof installation take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of a roof installation varies based on the roof's size, complexity, weather conditions, and the type of material being installed. Most residential roof replacements are completed within 3 to 7 days. Larger or more complex roofs, or those requiring extensive repairs to the underlying structure, may take longer. We aim to minimize disruption and will provide a detailed timeline after assessing your specific project.
